name: Qipao
dimensions: Length 106 cm; Width 95 cm; Depth 4 cm
summary: This dress is an early example of the Chinese style known as a cheongsam or qipao. The style was popularized in the mid- to late-1920s when women in China began to play a greater role in public life. One of the main features of this type of dress is the intricate knot and loop fastenings.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
